distinguishes: Rounding and the minimum step of the EIP-1559 update: integer division happens twice, an increase is at least 1 wei, a decrease can be 0, and the target is the floor of half the gas limit.

cases.name: full block at 7 wei rises by the 1 wei minimum
empty block at 7 wei cannot fall
partial excess truncates twice: floor(floor(100*5M/15M)/8) = floor(33/8) = 4
odd gas limit: target is floor(30000001/2) = 15000000
